manifest.name: dsh-lazygit-plugin
manifest.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的可视化 Git 工作台，支持查看仓库状态与提交记录、快捷执行常用 Git 操作，以及安全运行自然语言生成的分步骤命令提议。

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:js
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run verify:build
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm test && npm run verify:build && npm pack --dry-run

bundle.text:
# dsh-lazygit-plugin composition mount patch
#
# Temporary use: dsh web --patch ./lazygit.cordis.yml
# Persistent use: merge this patch into the profile's cordis.patch.yml, or into
# $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml for all profiles. Install this package first with
# dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-lazygit-plugin (or an equivalent command).
#
# package.json's dsh.bundle.patch only applies to packages listed in
# dsh.profile.bundles. A composition-row installation must use --patch or
# cordis.patch.yml. New top-level plugin rows must use insert; a direct
# `- id: lazygit / name: ...` entry only patches an existing id and is skipped.
- insert:
    - id: lazygit
      name: dsh-lazygit-plugin

readme.text: <div align="center">

**See your Git history and changes. Run everyday Git operations with a few clicks.** A visual Git workbench inside DeepSeek Harness Web. [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lazygit-plugin) [](https://github.com/IT-coder-Yy/dsh-lazygit-plugin) [](LICENSE) [](https://linux.do) English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

readme.section: Git you can see and use
readme.text:
**Understand your repository at a glance.** Browse the commit graph, inspect commit details and file diffs, compare staged and unstaged changes, and see branches, tags, stashes, and remote sync status in one workbench.

**Click through everyday Git work.** Stage files, commit, switch branches, merge, stash, fetch, pull, and push from the interface. Preview changes before merging and resolve conflicts in the built-in three-pane editor.

readme.section: Git you can see and use
readme.text:
| Area | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| Changes | Browse changed files by directory; review diffs with old/new line numbers and independently scrollable hunks, or switch to raw diffs; stage or unstage individual files or all changes; write a multiline message or use **AI Generate** to draft a Conventional Commit. |
| History | Browse the graph, inspect messages, parents, changed files and diffs; amend, undo, or revert commits. |
| Branches | Search, create, switch, and delete local branches; inspect remote branches and tags. |
| Merge | Preview incoming commits and changes; choose normal, fast-forward-only, or squash merge. |
| Conflicts | Compare current, incoming, and result panes; accept either side, keep both, or edit manually; save, resolve, and continue. |
| Stashes | Stash all or selected files, optionally including untracked files; review, apply, pop, drop, or create a branch from a stash. |
| Sync | Inspect upstream and ahead/behind counts; fetch, fast-forward pull, push, set upstream, and manage Rebase. |
| Suggestions | Chat with the independent Git assistant; review commands, explanations, and risks; execute a proposal step by step or copy it for manual execution; di

readme.section: Git you can see and use
readme.text: The command log at the bottom of the workbench shows the Git commands submitted through the interface and their running, success, or failure status. The workbench follows the host's light or dark theme.

If you installed `dsh-easygit-plugin` before, stop the Harness backend and run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-easygit-plugin` before installing the new package below. Existing assistant session links and proposal records are imported once, preserving the original storage and any records already present under the new name. For a manual installation, replace the old mount with the `lazygit` entry in [lazygit.cordis.yml](lazygit.cordis.yml). Refresh the browser after restarting.

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lazygit-plugin@0.5.3
dsh web
```

Open a session for your Git repository, then click the **Git** button beside the composer. The workbench opens in a native right-sidebar tab.

Use the compact **中文 / EN** control in the title bar to switch the workbench language. Your browser remembers the selection. Switching preserves the current tab and unsaved input; file paths, commit content, and raw Git output remain unchanged.

A typical workflow: **Changes → review the diff → stage files → enter a message → commit → Sync → push**. New branches can set their upstream when pushing.

If pnpm blocks installation because the package was recently published, add the package to the existing configuration in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - dsh-lazygit-plugin
```

In **Changes**, select a file to review its diff, stage the changes you want, then enter a message or click **AI Generate**. Review the message, commit, and open **Sync → Push**. New branches can set their upstream when pushing.

AI generation requires a configured model and sends it the staged diff and limited project context. Check the generated message before committing.

readme.section: 2. Switch branches, merge, and resolve conflicts
readme.text:
Create or switch branches in **Branches**. To set unfinished work aside, save it in **Stashes**; **apply** restores it while keeping the stash, and **pop** removes the stash after successful restoration.

With a clean worktree, open **Merge**, select a branch, preview its changes, and choose a merge method. Fetch first when using a remote branch. If conflicts occur, edit the result in **Conflicts**, then **save → mark resolved → continue**.

Open **Changes → Commit edits** to edit the latest message, add staged changes to the latest commit, or undo it while keeping your changes. These actions rewrite history, so check whether the commit has already been pushed. To reverse a commit with a new commit, select it in **History** and choose **Revert this commit**; this requires a clean worktree and index.

readme.section: 4. Use the Git assistant for complex operations
readme.text: Open **Suggestions → Expand Git assistant chat** and describe your goal. Review the proposed commands and risks, then confirm execution. Multi-step proposals stop at the first failure. You can ask the assistant to analyze failures; proposed repairs also require confirmation.

readme.section: Update, remove, or install from source
readme.text: ```sh

dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-lazygit-plugin
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-lazygit-plugin
```

After updating, restart the Harness backend and refresh the browser to load both Host and Client changes.

```sh

git clone https://github.com/IT-coder-Yy/dsh-lazygit-plugin.git
cd dsh-lazygit-plugin
npm install
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add "${PWD}"
```

You can also install directly from the repository with `dsh plugin --profile web add github:IT-coder-Yy/dsh-lazygit-plugin`.

| DSH version | Real-service smoke test | Working directory |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Earlier tested versions (`0.2.0-rc.1`–`0.2.1-rc.5`) | Passed | Original session directory; worktree changes supported from `0.2.1-alpha.2` |
| `0.2.2-alpha.2` | Passed ([pinned release-time dependencies](.github/fixtures/dsh-0.2.2-alpha.2.json)) | Current directory, including worktree changes |
| `0.2.2-alpha.3` | Passed | Current directory, including worktree changes |
| `0.2.2-rc.1` | Passed | Current directory, including worktree changes |

```sh
npm install
npm run check
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
```

`npm run check` runs type checks, tests, and build reproducibility checks. Git integration tests create temporary repositories for repository operations and recovery scenarios.

CI also runs `npm run test:dsh` against all versions covered above, including earlier tested releases. To reproduce one version locally:

```sh
npm install --prefix /tmp/lazygit-dsh-check @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.5
DSH_INSTALL_DIR=/tmp/lazygit-dsh-check npm run test:dsh
```

The smoke test uses and cleans up a temporary DSH_HOME and Git repository. It does not read existing sessions or call a model.

readme.section: Git 可视化，操作更简单
readme.text:
**仓库情况，一眼看清。** 用提交图浏览历史，点击查看提交详情与文件 Diff，对比已暂存和未暂存改动，在同一工作台掌握分支、标签、贮藏与远程同步状态。

**日常操作，点击完成。** 暂存、提交、切换分支、合并、贮藏、拉取和推送都可直接在界面操作。合并前先预览改动，遇到冲突用内置三方编辑器处理。

readme.section: Git 可视化，操作更简单
readme.text:
| 功能区 | 可以做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 变更 | 按目录树浏览文件；用双行号和逐块独立横向滚动审阅 Diff，或切换原始 Diff；暂存、取消暂存单个或全部文件；手写多行提交说明，或点击「AI 生成」填写约定式提交说明。 |
| 提交记录 | 浏览提交图、说明、父提交、变更文件及 Diff；修改、撤销或 Revert 提交。 |
| 分支 | 搜索、新建、切换和删除本地分支；查看远程分支与标签。 |
| 合并分支 | 预览待引入提交与文件改动；选择普通合并、仅快进或压缩合并。 |
| 冲突解决 | 对照当前方、传入方与结果；逐块选择一方、保留双方或手动编辑；保存、标记解决并继续。 |
| 贮藏 | 贮藏全部或指定文件，按需包含未跟踪文件；审阅、应用、弹出、删除或从贮藏创建分支。 |
| 同步 | 查看上游和领先/落后数量；获取更新、仅快进拉取、推送、设置上游，以及管理 Rebase。 |
| 建议 | 与独立 Git 助手对话；审阅命令、原因和风险；逐步执行提议或复制后手动执行；分析失败原因并审阅修复建议。 |

readme.section: Git 可视化，操作更简单
readme.text: 工作台底部的命令日志展示通过界面提交的 Git 命令，以及执行中、成功或失败状态。工作台跟随宿主的浅色或深色主题。

需要 Git、Node.js `>=24.9.0` 和 DeepSeek Harness Web。

如果之前安装过 `dsh-easygit-plugin`，请先停止 Harness 后端，执行 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-easygit-plugin`，再按下方命令安装新包。已有助手会话关联和提议记录会自动导入一次，保留旧存储，也不覆盖新名称下已有的记录；手动挂载的用户还需将旧挂载替换为 [lazygit.cordis.yml](lazygit.cordis.yml) 中的 `lazygit` 条目。重启后刷新浏览器即可。

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lazygit-plugin@0.5.3
dsh web
```

打开 Git 仓库对应的会话，点击输入框旁的 **Git** 按钮，即可在原生右侧标签页中打开工作台。

标题栏右侧的 **中文 / EN** 小按钮可切换工作台界面语言，浏览器会记住你的选择。切换时保留当前页签和未提交的输入；文件路径、提交内容与 Git 原始输出保持原文。

日常提交只需：**变更 → 审阅 Diff → 暂存文件 → 填写说明 → 提交 → 同步 → 推送**。新分支可以在推送时设置上游。

如果 pnpm 因包刚发布而暂缓安装，可在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的现有配置中加入：

```yaml
minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - dsh-lazygit-plugin
```

在 **变更** 页选择文件查看 Diff，暂存本次改动，填写提交说明或点击 **AI 生成**。检查说明并提交后，进入 **同步 → 推送**；新分支可在推送时设置上游。

AI 生成需先配置模型，会将暂存差异与少量项目背景发送给该模型，生成结果请在提交前检查。

readme.section: 2. 切换分支、合并与解决冲突
readme.text:
在 **分支** 页新建或切换分支。手头改动暂不提交时，可先用 **贮藏** 保存；恢复时，**应用** 保留贮藏，**弹出** 在恢复成功后删除贮藏。

工作区干净后，进入 **合并分支**，选择分支、预览改动并选择合并方式。使用远程分支前先获取更新。遇到冲突，在 **冲突解决** 中编辑结果，再按 **保存 → 标记解决 → 继续** 完成处理。
在 **变更 → 提交撤销与修正** 中，可修改最近提交说明、补充已暂存改动，或撤销最近提交并保留修改。这些操作会改写历史，请先确认提交是否已推送。若要用新提交抵消某次提交，在 **提交记录** 中选中它并点击 **Revert 此提交**，操作前需保持工作区与暂存区干净。

readme.section: 4. 用 Git 助手处理复杂操作
readme.text: 打开 **建议 → 展开 Git 助手聊天**，描述目标，审阅建议的命令与风险后确认执行。多步提议遇到失败即停止；可让助手分析原因，修复建议同样需要确认后执行。
```sh

dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-lazygit-plugin
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-lazygit-plugin
```

更新后重启 Harness 后端并刷新浏览器，确保 Host 和 Client 均加载新版本。

```sh

git clone https://github.com/IT-coder-Yy/dsh-lazygit-plugin.git
cd dsh-lazygit-plugin
npm install
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add "${PWD}"
```

也可直接从仓库安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:IT-coder-Yy/dsh-lazygit-plugin`。

| DSH 版本 | 真实服务冒烟测试 | 工作目录读取 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 此前已验证版本（`0.2.0-rc.1` 至 `0.2.1-rc.5`） | 通过 | 原有会话目录；自 `0.2.1-alpha.2` 起支持切换 worktree |
| `0.2.2-alpha.2` | 通过（[固定为发布时的依赖](.github/fixtures/dsh-0.2.2-alpha.2.json)） | 当前工作目录，支持切换 worktree |
| `0.2.2-alpha.3` | 通过 | 当前工作目录，支持切换 worktree |
| `0.2.2-rc.1` | 通过 | 当前工作目录，支持切换 worktree |

```sh
npm install
npm run check
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
```

`npm run check` 执行类型检查、测试与构建一致性检查。Git 集成测试会创建临时仓库，验证仓库操作与失败恢复场景。

CI 另对上表覆盖的全部 DSH 版本（含此前已验证版本）运行 `npm run test:dsh`。本地复现单个版本：

```sh
npm install --prefix /tmp/lazygit-dsh-check @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.5
DSH_INSTALL_DIR=/tmp/lazygit-dsh-check npm run test:dsh
```

测试使用临时 DSH_HOME 和 Git 仓库，结束后清理，不读取现有会话或调用模型。
